# GitHub Copilot Instructions

The canonical AI instructions live in `.ai/`.

Before generating or modifying code:

1. Read `.ai/README.md`.
2. Follow its progressive loading rules.
3. Load only the relevant files from `.ai/instructions/`.
4. Always follow `.ai/instructions/coding-guidelines.md` for Kotlin code.

Do not duplicate project rules here. This file exists only as the GitHub Copilot entry point.
